summary: ClearSign Technologies filed an 8-K noting it suspended an at-the-market (ATM) offering program. The registrant notified H.C. Wainwright of the termination of the July 2025 prospectus supplement; no shares had been sold under the agreement, and the full $10.39 million capacity remains available. The ATM agreement itself stays in effect, but no sales will occur without a new prospectus supplement. This is a routine administrative update regarding an equity facility, not a special situation event.
